facts.fact: Cybernetica states that in 2014 it and the e-Governance Academy introduced in Namibia an interoperability platform and a corresponding framework.
Cybernetica states that in its 2021-2022 capacity building project for the Office of the Prime Minister it helped Namibia update its interoperability framework document.

systems.owner: Office of the Prime Minister, Department of Public Service e-Government Management
systems.tiers: member organisations connecting databases of different entities; no count given
